issue.title: sase-core agent index open crashes instead of migrating when the DB schema_version stamp is ahead of the code version
issue.description:
Proposed by phase sase-1aq.10.7.5.7.2 (matched_deploy, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2) and routed by the sase-1aq.10.7.5.7 land agent.

1. On Athena (2026-09-27 ~06:50Z) the agent artifact index sqlite had its meta `schema_version` stamped 34 by some unreleased/workspace sase-core build; no released commit defines v34.
2. After `sase update` installed sase-core b57cd21 (code schema v33), `sase agent index status|verify|gc|rebuild` all crashed instead of migrating: because the stamped version was ahead of the code version, the open path skipped the v31 ensure-column step for `gate_shell_id`, then the unconditional `CREATE INDEX idx_agent_artifacts_gate_shell_id` batch failed with `no such column: gate_shell_id`.
3. The phase repaired Athena by resetting the stamp and replaying gc (sqlite backup `~/.sase/agent_artifact_index.sqlite.pre-matched-deploy-20260927T064040Z.bak` on Athena).

Suggested fix: make the index-creation batch ensure its columns unconditionally (idempotent ensure-column before CREATE INDEX), or have open handle a version-ahead stamp (treat as needing re-ensure / rebuild rather than skipping migrations). Add a regression that opens a DB stamped version+1 lacking the column.

task_type_fields.impact: Any host that ever ran a newer workspace build of sase-core bricks sase agent index status/verify/gc/rebuild after moving back to a released build; needs manual sqlite repair.
task_type_fields.location: sase-core crates/sase_core/src/agent_scan/index/storage.rs (index open / schema migration; CREATE INDEX idx_agent_artifacts_gate_shell_id)
task_type_fields.repro: Stamp an agent artifact index DB's meta schema_version to code_version+1 on a DB lacking gate_shell_id, then run sase agent index status: it fails 'no such column: gate_shell_id' instead of migrating.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1aq.10.7.5.7 phase .2 hit this while deploying matched builds to Athena; every sase agent index command crashed until a manual stamp reset.
